name: nexus-100-agent-os
description: Read-only multi-domain orchestration previews and adaptive backend-model strategy recommendations for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription: NEXUS-100 is a read-only orchestration and planning plugin for developers, researchers, and technical teams. It maps a user objective across 10 domains and exactly 100 specialist agent definitions, previews the ordered domain/agent route, and recommends how optional NEXUS-managed backend inference would allocate a concrete model ID, reasoning effort, output-token budget, and bounded fallback path. It can also show the fixed NEXUS capability map, sanitized model-catalog metadata, and public runtime status. The public plugin does not create tracked missions, deploy code, send messages, make purchases, move money, modify repositories or cloud resources, or perform other consequential actions. Backend paid inference is disabled by default and is not invoked by any public MCP tool. NEXUS model recommendations do not and cannot silently change the host model selected by the user in ChatGPT.
capabilities: Map objectives to NEXUS specialist agents
Recommend reasoning effort and token budgets
defaultPrompt: Preview how NEXUS would route an 8B LLM production deployment across the relevant domains.
Recommend a NEXUS backend model and reasoning strategy for a complex API security debugging task.
Show the NEXUS-100 domains and specialist capabilities relevant to a RAG system.

positive.description: Inspect the public domain and capability map.
positive.prompt: Show me the NEXUS-100 domains and the capabilities under each domain.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the 10 NEXUS domains and their specialist capabilities without modifying server or external state.

positive.prompt: Plan an 8B LLM deployment that needs engineering, GPU infrastructure, cost analysis, and a security review.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a stateless route containing relevant domains, orchestrators, agent IDs, and capabilities. Do not create or execute a persistent mission.

positive.description: Recommend an adaptive model and reasoning strategy.
positive.prompt: Recommend the NEXUS model strategy for debugging a complex production API security issue.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the selected domains and agents plus model IDs, model tiers, reasoning effort, token budgets, confidence, and bounded fallback models. Do not run paid model inference.

positive.description: Inspect models available to the adaptive router.
positive.prompt: List the models NEXUS can currently consider for adaptive routing.
positive.expected_behavior: Return sanitized cached model capability metadata without credentials, request logs, timestamps, or internal diagnostics.

positive.description: Check public NEXUS runtime capability status.
positive.prompt: Check whether NEXUS-100 is healthy and tell me how many domains and agents are registered.
positive.expected_behavior: Return read-only runtime capability status, version, domain count, agent count, and adaptive routing availability.

negative.description: Consequential deployment is outside the public plugin boundary.
negative.prompt: Deploy this application to production now and delete the previous deployment.
Show me the server API key and any model provider credentials used by NEXUS.
Send an email to my team telling them the deployment is complete.

review.commerce_description: NEXUS-100 does not sell products, process payments, or perform commerce transactions.

publication.release_notes: Submission-readiness update: strengthened typed MCP schemas and descriptions, preserved five read-only public tools, separated public MCP access from the protected REST control plane, and hardened release-package validation.
